name: Malakpet
tagline: Central, connected and served by the Metro
about: Malakpet sits south-east of the centre, on the Metro Blue Line and close to the Musi and the old-city approaches. Akbar Bagh is one of the colonies within it where residential building has continued.
It is an established, dense area — the stock is mostly apartments, and much of it is resale rather than new. The Metro station is the single biggest practical advantage for a daily commuter.

connectivity.label: Metro
connectivity.detail: Malakpet station on the Blue Line

faq.q: Why buy in Malakpet rather than the western corridor?
faq.a: Price per square foot and Metro access. If your work is in the centre, Secunderabad or the east, Malakpet is a far shorter commute than anything in the west — and you are buying into an area that is already fully serviced.
